findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_webhooks, get_delivery_log · Private data: get_account, add_webhook · Public sink: list_webhooks, add_webhook, create_subscription · Destructive: remove_subscription.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_webhooks, get_delivery_log · Private data: get_account, add_webhook · Public sink: list_webhooks, add_webhook, create_subscription · Destructive: remove_subscription

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
